answer:
Your Habits note now has a tracker page. Open it in Amber Notes and use the Page view. I haven't opened the page on a device, so I haven't tested the ticking.

- **Today:** there are four big tick buttons, one each for walk, read, stretch and no phone in bed. Each shows its current streak and your best streak.
- **History:** a 14-day grid shows the days you did each habit. Tap any square to fix a past day.
- **Layout:** it works on a phone and on a wider screen.

To make this work I rewrote the note's text into a table with one row per day. I used Yes/No for each habit and put your old entries in as rows from 28 Sep to 4 Oct. I added a blank row for today, 5 Oct. Your comments ("too tired" and "party") are now one line under the table. A day with no row counts as not done, and ticking a day that has no row adds one.

I read "sat 3 walk, read" as no stretch and no no-phone-in-bed, and did the same for the other days. The streaks depend on that reading, so check the table if any look wrong.
